text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When all of today's training had ended—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Admire Vega began walking
in the exact opposite direction of the changing room.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Through the park, and then back and forth along the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"If I head up to the hilltop park from here and turn back,
it'll be just in time for curfew."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I can still run.
I'm going to continue training."
choice_data_list: Let's save our strength for tomorrow

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Keep up with me...?
There's no way you could ever keep pace with me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Well, fine. In that case, I'll be doing laps
around the track today, so please check my form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I stayed late to accompany
Admire Vega on her running drills.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I run this much extra,
I'll still be able to handle tomorrow's practice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained to Admire Vega
the importance of letting her body rest.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...If you insist that much, I'll pass.
It's not like you're speaking without thinking, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Still, in return, you'd better put in an equal amount of training tomorrow."
